Validate against a strict allowlist regex (e.g. ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ with additional rule disallowing leading '-'), or prefix arguments with '--' to terminate option parsing, and resolve/confirm the path stays within an intended directory.

ImageMagick's 'convert'/delegate mechanism can be abused via crafted file contents (e.g. MSL, embedded shell delegates) leading to command execution or SSRF; run conversion in a sandboxed/restricted policy.xml environment, disable vulnerable coders, and avoid trusting untrusted file content/extension pairing without validating actual file type.
No timeout is set, allowing a malicious or malformed input file to hang the process indefinitely (resource exhaustion); add a timeout parameter and handle subprocess.TimeoutExpired.
